data.one_liner: Enables Firebase OAuth on desktop platforms via webview.
data.what_it_does: Provides OAuth sign-in flows for desktop apps using a webview. Supports providers such as Google, Facebook, Twitter, and GitHub.
use_when: You need Firebase OAuth authentication on Windows, macOS, or Linux desktop apps
You want to handle Google, Facebook, or Twitter sign-ins via webview
avoid_when: You only need mobile or web authentication and do not target desktop platforms
strengths: Brings OAuth support to desktop platforms where standard mobile auth plugins may not work
Supports multiple providers including Google, Facebook, Twitter, and GitHub
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration like WebKit2GTK on Linux or network entitlements on macOS
data.setup_notes: Requires macOS Release.entitlements network server key, and Linux WebKit2GTK development libraries.
